The '''Galactic Fair''' (called the '''Imperial Fair''' in the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]) was the highlight of [[Fete Week]], and was a traditional fair held annually on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Fair was held along [[Glitannai Esplanade]] and incorporated dancing, acrobatics, shopping, technology exhibits, food pavilions, and a massive parade of military might. From the surrounding spires, thousands watched as the parade ended in ''[[Pliada di am Imperium]]''. There, at the base of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], dignitaries would bestow blessings on the crowd from an open-air balcony. The Galactic Fair was also the site of the [[Grand Display]], which included exhibits created by various [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] governments.
